about: The chorus of the effect rack of the Audio Unit on samples of ours played by its noise oscillator (44.1 kHz), its plain params named as its state has them (kParamRate Hz, kParamDelay and kParamDelay2 ms, kParamDepth 0..26, kParamFeedback %, kParamFilt Hz, kParamFiltMode 1 a high pass, kParamWet %, kParamLevelOut a knob 0..1). delays: [Delay 1, Delay 2, the taps of the left channel (ms after the dry click), of the right one] at the depth 0. fresh: the defaults of its knobs and how far a render with them written is from the one of a fresh chorus (dB under it). lfo: trains of clicks (the knobs of each, the rest fresh, the mix 100 %, the filter open, no feedback; a tone of 1 kHz at 0.001 under the clicks, fading out over their last 2000 samples: the chorus awake): taps [the time of a click (s after the first), where the left channel brings it out (ms, in order), the right one]. feedback: [%, the repeats of a click [ms, gain]] with both delays 10 ms, loops the same with Delay 2 at 7 ms and 50 %. filter: low and high pass, [the knob (Hz), the gain of the wet signal (dB against the dry click) at each of frequencies] with both taps at 0 ms and no feedback. comb: [feedback %, the same gains] with both delays 10 ms. mix: [the knob 0..1, the gain of the dry click, the gain of the wet one (two taps at once)], level: [the knob, the dry gain (dB), the wet gain (dB)] at the mix 50 %. mono: a fresh chorus on white noise (x = x * 1664525 + 1013904223 mod 2^32 from 1, its top 24 bits as -0.25..0.25) over 0.2..13 s: the level of each channel and of the half sum (dB against the dry noise). scripts/renders/run.mjs --only=chorus
